## 1.3.31 (HexGhoul): a spouse who actually helps at home: cooks (and keeps you a meal), smelts, harvests and replants, guards the house and the kids; nobody greets or talks to you through walls; /kagune home (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.31 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 66**, unchanged from 1.3.30). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **No more through walls.** Your spouse, your children and the ghouls who walk with you only come up to you, greet you or say anything unprompted when they can actually see you, close by. No more greetings from outside the house or lines from the next room. A speech bubble also only shows when you can see who's talking.
- **"Welcome home" when they really see you.** Back after a while, your spouse waits until they actually see you come in (any time in the next minute), then greets you and hugs you.
- **They cook, and keep you a meal.** With raw food in the home's chests and a stove (a furnace or a smoker with coal, charcoal or wood in a chest, or a campfire with no fuel needed), your spouse fetches the food from the chest, goes to the stove and cooks: a bowl in one hand, stirring, smoke and a little flame. The fuel comes out of the chests too. They keep a meal for you (up to six portions) and put the rest back in the chests. When you come home they hand it to you ("Welcome home. I cooked..."), or straight away if you're there when it's done.
  - **A ghoul spouse for a ghoul partner:** cooked food won't stay down for a ghoul, so if you're a ghoul they don't cook meat for you. They set the raw cuts aside at a table ("I put the good cuts aside for you. Raw.").
  - **Out of fuel:** they'll tell you (once a day): "We're out of coal."
- **They smelt.** Raw iron, gold and copper, ores, sand, red sand, cobblestone, clay, netherrack and logs (into charcoal) left in the chests get smelted at a furnace or blast furnace with fuel from the chests, and the ingots, glass and so on go back in. Nothing is ever lost or duplicated: what's taken out is put back in the same moment, and a batch never uses more fuel than is left (a log being smelted can't also be its own fuel).
- **They harvest and replant.** Ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroots get picked, the plant is left to grow again, and what it gave goes into the nearest chest (nothing is picked if there's no room). Then they tidy that chest. Ripe crops come before anything else.
- **The house comes before cuddles.** When a chore is due they put the child down and get on with it, instead of holding the baby around all day.
- **They guard the house and the kids.** Anything hostile on the home's ground that they can see, that's right by the house (within 10 blocks), or that's going after you, a child or them gets dealt with. At night, something hostile near them gets them out of bed.
- **`/kagune home` (new, anyone).** Shows what your spouse makes of your home: whether they're at it, what they found (chests, stoves, plants, tables, shelves, windows), what they can do right now (cook, smelt, how many ripe crops, out of fuel, no plain chest), what they're doing, and the meal they're keeping for you. Use it when a chore doesn't seem to happen: it tells you why.
- Still from 1.3.29 to 1.3.30: tidying chests, sweeping things into a chest, wiping tables, watering, reading, looking out of windows; speech bubbles over their heads.

Untested in game: all of it is compiled and unit tested only. Please try `/kagune home` first: it shows what they found and what they can do.
